# طبانا (Tebana)

> منصة طبية مصرية لحجز الأطباء الموثّقين — كشف في العيادة أو استشارة بالفيديو، سعر معلن قبل الحجز، وسجل طبي يبقى مع المريض. تديرها شركة طبانا للخدمات الإلكترونية. الاسم السابق: طبيبي (Tabibi).

Tebana (formerly Tabibi) is an Egyptian healthcare platform: patients find manually verified doctors, book clinic visits or video consultations with the price shown up front, and keep an encrypted medical record. Doctors run bookings, a waiting-room queue, e-prescriptions and patient records from one dashboard, with 0% commission on clinic visits and 10% on online consultations.

## الصفحات الأساسية / Key pages
- [الرئيسية / Home](https://mytabibi.com/): search by specialty, doctor name or symptom; "near me" geographic search
- [الأطباء / Doctors](https://mytabibi.com/doctors): verified doctors list with filters
- [الأقرب لي / Near me](https://mytabibi.com/nearby): doctors around the patient's location
- [التخصصات / Specialties](https://mytabibi.com/doctors): one landing page per specialty at https://mytabibi.com/specialty/{slug}
- [المقالات / Articles](https://mytabibi.com/articles): medical articles written by doctors
- [للأطباء / For doctors](https://mytabibi.com/join-doctor): how a doctor joins and gets verified
- [الأسعار / Pricing](https://mytabibi.com/pricing): Free and Gold plans for doctors
- [كيف تعمل / How it works](https://mytabibi.com/how-it-works)
- [عن طبانا / About](https://mytabibi.com/about)
- [تواصل معنا / Contact](https://mytabibi.com/contact)

## حقائق / Facts
- Country: Egypt. Currency: Egyptian pound (EGP). Languages: Arabic (primary), English.
- Every doctor's license and certificates are reviewed by hand before the profile is published; verified profiles carry a "موثّق" badge.
- Booking types: clinic visit (paid at the clinic) and video consultation (paid online).
- Medical records are encrypted and visible only to the patient and the doctors they choose.
- Mobile apps: Android and iOS (package com.mytabibi.app).
